description:
Establish byte-field vector and matrix comparison arms. Establish reproducible operation-equivalent external baselines without changing production kernels.

## Background

Existing FieldVec and FieldMatrix consumers do not imply byte-packed region semantics. M4RIE provides a matrix comparator; ISA-L and GF-Complete provide candidates for genuinely matching fixed-coefficient operations. Existing M4RIE receipts identify reusable survey context, not current before measurements.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Satisfy the [Zen 3 measurement contract](dev/active/1a379447-zen3-cpu-performance/measurement-contract.md) for correctness, reproducible release benchmarks, comparison validity and adoption; receipts pin its committed version, the frozen protocol and the cell addendum. Include mandatory before/after evidence for production changes and preserve negative outcomes.

- [hard] REQ-02: Pin M4RIE, GF-Complete and ISA-L revisions, licenses, compiler targeting and selected arithmetic backends. Reuse existing comparator harnesses and M4RIE build provenance where applicable, while verifying the pinned source remains suitable.

- [hard] REQ-03: Map FieldVec::axpy and batched matrix cells to equivalent external operations with explicit field polynomial/basis, coefficient reuse, accumulation and overlap semantics. Record missing equivalents; a matrix multiply is not a region multiply-XOR.

- [hard] REQ-04: Validate adapters against shared field/conformance evidence before timing. Include byte/u64 conversion, table preparation, setup and output costs; distinguish arbitrary pairwise multiplication and fixed-coefficient reuse.

- [hard] REQ-05: Commit frozen family addenda and current baseline receipts for admissible cells across relevant sizes/cache regimes. Document 0x11B/0x11D mismatches and any supported basis conversion instead of comparing incompatible fields.

## Notes

Pin exact source and build identities in the family addendum. Preserve unavailable, incompatible and losing arms rather than substituting a different operation.

Source references: [Mfourrie2026], [IsaL2026], [GfComplete2026].
title: Establish byte-field vector and matrix comparison arms
